name: Infant And Adult Baptism
overview: Scripture emphasizes the necessity of spiritual birth through water and the Spirit as essential for entering the kingdom of God, highlighting personal repentance and baptism for the remission of sins. Jesus welcomed children, affirming their place in God's kingdom, while also instructing believers to nurture their children in the Lord. The early church example shows entire households being baptized upon faith, demonstrating both individual belief and family inclusion in baptism.
